responsibility: Implements GCC’s RTL data dependence graph for instruction scheduling, especially modulo/software pipelining of loops. It builds DDG nodes from loop insns, derives register and memory dependence edges with latency, distance, and dependence-kind information from df and sched dependency data, prunes selected anti-dependences for regmove-based scheduling, records backarcs, and provides graph algorithms for predecessor/path queries and SCC discovery with recurrence-length computation used to characterize scheduling cycles.
same_name_distinction: Implements the ddg interface declared in gcc/ddg.h: it actually builds and mutates RTL dependence graphs for scheduling, computes edges/backarcs, and performs SCC/path analysis, whereas the header only defines the DDG types, enums, macros, and APIs.
